responsibility: Declares abstract custom_edge_info subclasses for representing modeled call outcomes on exploded-graph edges. The call_info hierarchy stores the originating gcall and callee fndecl, emits user-facing path events, and provides reusable success/failure wording layers that concrete known-function bifurcation handlers override to update caller state or memory models for each outcome.
same_name_distinction: Declares the abstract call_info hierarchy of custom_edge_info subclasses that represent modeled call outcomes on exploded-graph edges. Unlike call-details.h, it describes edge/outcome metadata rather than the immediate call-site adapter, and unlike call-info.cc it contains only the class interfaces.
